summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill addressing parameter validation during AgentOps client configuration—a focused, specialized capability not present in existing skills. Peer candidates (Client Initialization, Thread-Safe Singleton, Initialization Setup) cover broader initialization workflows but do not address validation logic. Existing skills are unrelated (ProcessPoolExecutor, Gradle BootJar). Candidate has clear support evidence and well-defined constraints/cautions. No semantic overlap with existing registry.
